cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Help Me Make This Normal
cards.instruction: Get someone to help perform the strange behavior until it feels ordinary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Our invisible dinner guest is here. Will you introduce Mum while I finish the gravy?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't see where to look.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. The chair beside you. Just introduce them as you normally would.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Hello, chair, this is Mum. She needs your seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Introduce her to the guest, love. Then fetch another chair; we can't ask someone to stand just because Mum can't see them.

mechanism: A corrects a helper's guest introduction and seating priorities, treating an invisible guest as an ordinary person needing competent hospitality.
confusable: Merely accepting invisibility is insufficient; A must get B to perform the social task properly.
comparison: Family introductions and seating pressure differ from training a workplace greeting ritual.
seedUse: Keep the invisible guest and actual introduction mistake; remove two stock declarations that obscure specific supervision.
